acceptance_criteria: Acceptance of p0-open-decisions extended (or the questions given their own beads); calendar adjusted to the confirmed freeze
description:
DECISIONS.md lists eight open questions and says they are seeded as p0-open-decisions (plus p0-host, p0-school-it, p0-consent). The bead's acceptance criteria cover only the kit slug/prefix, the module outline and networked electronics. It omits the retention period (question 7; p9-retention needs it), who enters quiz results and whether the quiz is still paper and picture-based (question 8; p7-quiz needs it), and whether mid-December is still the freeze (REVIEW 'could not settle' item 6, assumption A3), which the whole calendar rests on.

Also: the suggested calendar has Phase 9 (Dec 13-16) overlapping Phase 10 (Dec 14-18), though p10-prod-infra depends on p9-load.

Filed during beads setup (prompt 01, step 8).
title: DECISION: p0-open-decisions acceptance omits retention, quiz entry and the freeze date
